steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates discussed Project Sunrise, saying Qantas ordered 12 Airbus A350s to fly nonstop from Australia to cities like New York and London, with cabins set up for very long flights as part of its update.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Qantas faced headwinds despite a rally, citing a $100 million ghost flights fine, oil price risks, Middle East tensions and increased competition from Qatar.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Henry Jennings - Liontown, Zip, Qantas, NextDC, Lynas & more

views.text: In January 2023, a guest on Equity Mates said strong demand and a domestically dominant market let higher airfares support Qantas’ earnings as it shifted focus back to profitability over growth.

episode.title: 23 Stocks for 2023 | Elders, Playside, Qantas and more! Pt I

views.text: In June 2021, a guest on Equity Mates explained Qantas’ profits were driven by domestic routes with valuable peak-time slots largely held by Qantas or Virgin, and described aggressive responses on regional routes to challengers.

episode.title: Three fundamental rules of investing with Kyle Macintyre | ASX Week

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In October 2024, a guest on Equity Mates noted hopes dividends would return given a relatively strong balance sheet, while also pointing to recent penalties and competitive pressures.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Henry Jennings - Liontown, Zip, Qantas, NextDC, Lynas & more

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates noted Qantas committing capital to 12 A350s for ultra long-haul routes from late 2025, outlining a significant fleet investment decision.

In June 2021, a guest on Equity Mates described how Qantas raised asset-backed funding against aircraft at 2.75 percent and cut cash burn from about $500 million to below $200 million per month to survive Covid.

episode.title: Three fundamental rules of investing with Kyle Macintyre | ASX Week

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said the share price had run from roughly $5.50, 6.00 to around $7.00 and described it as having shot ahead after leadership change, while outlining ongoing risks.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Henry Jennings - Liontown, Zip, Qantas, NextDC, Lynas & more

views.text: In September 2023, Equity Mates observed the share price rose about 4 percent from January 2008 to the episode date, or about 120 percent from November 2008, and noted limited dividends in 2017, 2019.

episode.title: What next for QANTAS, Andrew Page on Reporting Season & the ESG debate continues

views.text: In June 2021, a guest on Equity Mates used Qantas to illustrate valuation, saying it historically traded around nine times earnings but fell to about four times in March 2020, implying fears of failure or a large capital raising.
